articles.summary: Kemper Corporation (NYSE: KMPR) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.32 per share. The dividend is payable on December 2, 2026, to Kemper’s shareholders of record as of November 16, 2026. About Kemper The Kemper family of companies is one of the nation's leading specialized insurers. With approximately $12 billion in assets, Kemper is improving the world of insurance by providing affordable and easy-to-use personalized solutions to individuals, families and businesses through its Kemper Auto and Kemper Life brands. Kemper serves over 4.4 million policies, is represented by 24,100 agents and brokers, and has 7,000 associates dedicated to meeting the ever-changing needs of its customers. Learn more about Kemper . Investors: Michael Marinaccio, 312.661.4930 or investors@kemper.com Media: Barbara Ciesemier, 312.661.4521 or bciesemier@kemper.com Source: Kemper Corporation

articles.summary: Kemper has taken a series of rate reductions for its Florida auto customers as insurance market conditions in the state have improved following legislative reforms that significantly reduced legal system abuse in Florida. Relatedly, Kemper worked collaboratively with the Florida Office of Insurance Regulation to return approximately $46.2 million covering the 20232025 period in accordance with Florida statutory obligations. Kemper expects to begin notifying customers who qualify for credits or refunds on November 19. Current customers who qualify will receive credits to their accounts, while former customers who qualify will receive refunds. Floridas auto insurance market has shown meaningful improvement, and we are pleased that our customers are benefiting through lower rates, said Stephen J. McAnena, President and CEO of Kemper.
